data.summary_en: Propose CacheFit, combining ChampSim with HARCOM circuit-level cost model and LLMs, adding latency, area, and power to search objectives, generating Fit-MPPPB from MPPPB; storage 60.3% lower, static power 56.3% lower, transistors 58.9% lower, IPC 1.1% higher, SPEC CPU2017 hit rate 7.5 percentage points higher.
